messages:
emma: Heads up — Acme Support escalation: multiple customers seeing short 503s from hosted streaming API since 10:04 UTC. Customer reports partial responses then connection close.
raj: Noted. I see a 503 spike on gateway-prod cluster at 10:05-10:12 (p95 errors). Correlates with an autoscaler config push around 10:03. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/boards/streaming-503s
morgan: I can try to repro — which endpoint & payload size?
emma: /v1/stream (chat/completions streaming). They reported long-lived streams (avg token burst ~800). Customer provided a minimal example.
olivia: Customer impact: a handful of high-traffic customers intermittently hitting errors during peak. They're asking for mitigation and ETA.
raj: Quick mitigations: 1) pin routing to older gateway variant 2) bump keepalive timeout 3) temporarily disable new scaler aggressiveness. I can toggle 1 & 2 fast.
deploy-bot: deploy started by raj: rollback autoscaler-config v2024-11-03-1030 -> target gateway-prod (ETA ~2m)
morgan: Repro steps I used (local):
```
# parallel 6 clients
for i in {1..6}; do \
  curl -Ns -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"token storm"}],"max_tokens":800}' \
  https://api.redwood.dev/v1/stream &
done
```
I see a few connections drop with HTTP/2 RST_STREAM and a 503 body from gateway.
emma: Can you paste the short gateway log lines?
raj: sample gateway log snippets (10:05:06): `proxy: upstream error: HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable; conn reset; kv_cache_deadline exceeded` and (10:06:12): `router: stream connection closed: unexpected EOF`
morgan: When I limit concurrency to 2 clients the repro disappears. So likely a capacity or transient connection handling bug under moderate concurrency + long streams.
raj: Rollback completed. Rolling traffic to stable gateway-2024-10-28. Observability will show drop in 503s in ~60s.
olivia: Notified Acme update: told them we rolled back and are investigating root cause.
emma: Thanks. Please collect: repro script, exact log snippets, autoscaler change diff, gateway config diff, and the time-windowed traces for a few affected requests.
raj: Action items: 1) collect traces/logs (raj) 2) produce minimal reproducer repo & perf matrix (morgan) 3) deep-dive on autoscaler/gateway interaction (eng-runtime + raj) 4) customer comms draft & SLA impact note (olivia) — aim to have initial postmortem stub in 2 business hours.
morgan: I'll open an internal GH issue with the reproducer and attach perf traces.
emma: One more ask — if we see any auth/billing errors correlated with these 503s call it out (so CS can separate from billing break).
raj: Confirming no billing/KMS errors in the same window in logs. Looks isolated to gateway stream handling.
olivia: I'll send customer a brief timeline + current mitigations.
emma: Great. I'll keep this thread updated as we get traces. :thumbsup:
